desc:
Welcome to the fourth instalment in the Broken Bones series.
Built in 2018, expanding on the original 2009 game and it's sequels.

Broken Bones is the original ragdoll simulator game on Roblox. Jump off cliffs and break bones to unlock new levels, upgrades, utilities and much more!



Sixth Annual Bloxy award winner!

The fifth Broke Bones game can be found here:
https://www.roblox.com/games/11179373590/Broken-Bones-5

scripts.features:
# Horizon Hub | Bone Breaker Edition

A WindUI-based Roblox hub featuring automation, movement utilities, live statistics, configuration management, and customizable settings.

**Features**

**Auto Strike**
- Auto Strike
- Auto Farm Sync
- FAST, POWER & COMBO modes
- Adjustable Strike Power (10–200%)
- Hit Effects Toggle
- Adjustable Effect Size (1–10)
- Manual Single Hit
- Start / Stop Controls
- Reset Counters

**Statistics**
- Live Broken Bones Counter
- Hits Per Second Tracking
- Maximum Velocity Tracking
- Live Session Timer
- Copy Statistics
- Reset Statistics
- Broken Bones & Velocity Tracking Toggles

**Movement**
- Forward Dash
- Upward Boost
- Adjustable Dash Power
- Position Lock
- Stop Velocity
- Character Respawn

**Configuration**
- Save Configurations
- Load Configurations
- Delete Configurations
- Saved Config Selection
- Custom Config Names
- Reset Config Name to Default
- Save Settings

**Interface & Settings**
- Live FPS Counter
- Live Ping Display
- Player Profile Information
- RightShift Menu Toggle (Customizable)
- Notifications Toggle
- Auto Start Features Toggle
- Anti-AFK
- Close Hub Button
- Automatic Cleanup of Active Connections on Close
- Kick Call Suppression
- Midnight Theme
- Draggable Open Button
- Customizable Interface Effects

**Additional Details**
- Real-time strike automation
- Persistent configuration support through WindUI
- Session monitoring
- Customizable visual feedback
- Horizon Hub v1.2

**Credits:** Horizon Hub © 2026  
Open-source project. Please preserve the original credits when redistributing or modifying the project.

local WindUI = nil
local WindUIOk = pcall(function()
    WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua"))()
end)
if not WindUIOk or not WindUI then warn("Horizon Hub: WindUI failed to load, check your internet connection."); return end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Red = Color3.fromHex("#FF4040")
local Orange = Color3.fromHex("#FF8C00")
local Green = Color3.fromHex("#10C550")
local Blue = Color3.fromHex("#3B9EFF")
local Purple = Color3.fromHex("#7775F2")
local Yellow = Color3.fromHex("#ECA201")
local Grey = Color3.fromHex("#A0A0A0")
local White = Color3.fromHex("#FFFFFF")

local notificationsEnabled = true
local showEffects = true
local effectSize = 3

local function getHRP()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot()
    return LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function notify(title, content, icon, duration)
    if not notificationsEnabled then return end
    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = title,
        Content = content,
        Icon = icon or "solar:bell-bold",
        Duration = duration or 3,
    })
end

pcall(function()
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if method == "Kick" then return end
        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end)
    setreadonly(mt, true)
end)

local breaker = {
    active = false,
    mode = "FAST",
    power = 1,
    totalBones = 0,
    maxDamage = 0,
    dps = 0
}

local modeSettings = {
    ["FAST"] = { vel = 150, int = 0.3, cnt = 1 },
    ["POWER"] = { vel = 350, int = 1, cnt = 1 },
    ["COMBO"] = { vel = 200, int = 0.15, cnt = 5 }
}

local function createEffect(pos)
    if not showEffects then return end
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    p.Position = pos
    p.Anchored = true
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38)
    p.Transparency = 0.3
    p.Parent = workspace
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        pcall(function() p:Destroy() end)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { Size = Vector3.new(effectSize, effectSize, effectSize), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
    end)
end

local function performHit()
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then return end
    local settings = modeSettings[breaker.mode]
    if not settings then return end
    local velocity = settings.vel * breaker.power
    local ray = Ray.new(root.Position, root.CFrame.LookVector * 20)
    local hit, pos = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, { LocalPlayer.Character })
    if hit then
        createEffect(pos)
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
        bv.Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * velocity
        bv.Parent = root
        Debris:AddItem(bv, 0.1)
        breaker.totalBones = breaker.totalBones + 1
        if velocity > breaker.maxDamage then
            breaker.maxDamage = math.floor(velocity)
        end
    end
end

local lastHit = tick()
local dmgCount = 0
local lastDmgCheck = tick()
local connection = nil

local function autoLoop()
    if not breaker.active then return end
    if not getRoot() then return end
    local now = tick()
    local settings = modeSettings[breaker.mode]
    if not settings then return end
    if now - lastHit >= settings.int then
        for i = 1, settings.cnt do
            performHit()
            if settings.cnt > 1 then task.wait(0.05) end
        end
        lastHit = now
        dmgCount = dmgCount + 1
    end
    if now - lastDmgCheck >= 1 then
        breaker.dps = dmgCount
        dmgCount = 0
        lastDmgCheck = now
    end
end

local function startFarm()
    if not breaker.active then
        breaker.active = true
        if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(autoLoop)
    end
end

local function stopFarm()
    if breaker.active then
        breaker.active = false
        if connection then
            pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
            connection = nil
        end
    end
end

local posLockActive = false
local lockedCFrame = nil
local posLockConn = nil

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Horizon Hub",
    SubTitle = "Bone Breaker Edition",
    TabWidth = 160,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 460),
    Folder = "HorizonHub",
    Theme = "Midnight",
    Themeable = { Background = false },
    HidePanelBackground = true,
    NewElements = false,
    HideSearchBar = false,
    Icon = "solar:shield-check-bold-duotone",
    Topbar = { Height = 44, ButtonsType = "Default" },
    OpenButton = {
        Title = "Horizon Hub",
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0),
        StrokeThickness = 2,
        Enabled = true,
        Draggable = true,
        OnlyMobile = false,
        Scale = 1.15,
        Color = ColorSequence.new(
            Color3.fromHex("#FF6B6B"),
            Color3.fromHex("#FF8E53")
        ),
    },
    User = {
        Enabled = true,
        Anonymous = false,
        Callback = function()
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Profile",
                Content = LocalPlayer.DisplayName .. " • @" .. LocalPlayer.Name,
                Icon = "solar:user-bold",
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    },
})

pcall(function() Window:SetPanelBackground(false) end)

Window:Tag({ Title = "v1.2", Icon = "solar:tag-bold", Color = Purple, Border = true })

local fpsTag = Window:Tag({ Title = "FPS: --", Icon = "solar:cpu-bolt-bold", Color = Green, Border = true })
local pingTag = Window:Tag({ Title = "Ping: --ms", Icon = "solar:radar-bold", Color = Yellow, Border = true })

Window:Tag({ Title = "✦ Premium Quality", Icon = "solar:shield-check-bold", Color = Purple, Border = true })

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        local fps = math.floor(1 / RunService.Heartbeat:Wait())
        local ok, ping = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
        end)
        fpsTag:SetTitle("FPS: " .. fps)
        pingTag:SetTitle("Ping: " .. (ok and math.floor(ping) or "??") .. "ms")
    end
end)

local FarmSection = Window:Section({ Title = "Farm" })
local TeleportSection = Window:Section({ Title = "Teleport" })
local InterfaceSection = Window:Section({ Title = "Interface" })
local SettingsSection = Window:Section({ Title = "Settings" })

local StrikeTab = FarmSection:Tab({
    Title = "Auto Strike",
    Desc = "Core bone breaker automation",
    Icon = "solar:bone-broken-bold",
    IconColor = Red,
    IconShape = "Square",
    Border = true,
})

StrikeTab:Paragraph({
    Title = "Bone Breaker Strike Center",
    Desc = "Choose a strike mode, tune your power, then start farming. Every hit uses forward velocity impact.",
    Image = "solar:bone-broken-bold",
    ImageSize = 36,
})

StrikeTab:Space()

local ModeSection = StrikeTab:Section({
    Title = "Strike Mode",
    Desc = "Select how the breaker hits. Each mode has unique velocity and interval.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

local intervalPara = ModeSection:Paragraph({
    Title = "Current Interval",
    Desc = "Interval: 0.3 sec | Hits per cycle: 1",
    Image = "solar:clock-circle-bold",
    ImageSize = 28,
})

ModeSection:Space()

local modeDropdown = ModeSection:Dropdown({
    Flag = "StrikeMode",
    Title = "Strike Mode",
    Desc = "FAST many hits, POWER max damage, COMBO hit series.",
    Icon = "solar:target-bold",
    IconColor = Red,
    Values = { "FAST", "POWER", "COMBO" },
    Value = "FAST",
    Callback = function(val)
        breaker.mode = val
        local s = modeSettings[val]
        if s and intervalPara and intervalPara.SetDesc then
            intervalPara:SetDesc("Interval: " .. tostring(s.int) .. " sec | Hits per cycle: " .. tostring(s.cnt))
        end
        notify("Strike Mode", "Mode set to " .. tostring(val), "solar:target-bold")
    end,
})

ModeSection:Space()

ModeSection:Toggle({
    Flag = "ShowHitEffects",
    Title = "Show Hit Effects",
    Desc = "Display neon impact effect on every successful hit.",
    Icon = "solar:stars-bold",
    IconColor = Yellow,
    Type = "Checkbox",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(state)
        showEffects = state
        notify("Effects", state and "Hit effects enabled." or "Hit effects disabled.", "solar:stars-bold")
    end,
})

StrikeTab:Space()

local PowerSection = StrikeTab:Section({
    Title = "Strike Power",
    Desc = "Fine tune velocity multiplier and visual impact size.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

PowerSection:Slider({
    Flag = "StrikePower",
    Title = "Strike Power",
    Desc = "Velocity multiplier from 10 percent to 200 percent.",
    Icon = "solar:bolt-bold",
    IconColor = Orange,
    IsTooltip = true,
    IsTextbox = true,
    Icons = { From = "sfsymbols:sunMinFill", To = "sfsymbols:sunMaxFill" },
    Step = 1,
    Value = { Min = 10, Max = 200, Default = 100 },
    Callback = function(v)
        breaker.power = v / 100
        notify("Strike Power", "Power set to " .. tostring(v) .. "%", "solar:bolt-bold")
    end,
})

PowerSection:Space()

PowerSection:Slider({
    Flag = "EffectSize",
    Title = "Effect Size",
    Desc = "Size of the neon impact effect on hit.",
    Icon = "solar:maximize-bold",
    IconColor = Purple,
    IsTooltip = true,
    IsTextbox = true,
    Icons = { From = "sfsymbols:sunMinFill", To = "sfsymbols:sunMaxFill" },
    Step = 1,
    Value = { Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = 3 },
    Callback = function(v)
        effectSize = v
        notify("Effect Size", "Effect size set to " .. tostring(v), "solar:maximize-bold")
    end,
})

StrikeTab:Space()

local ControlSection = StrikeTab:Section({
    Title = "Automation Control",
    Desc = "Start, stop, and automate the bone breaking loop.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

ControlSection:Toggle({
    Flag = "AutoStrike",
    Title = "Auto Strike",
    Desc = "Automatically perform strikes using the selected mode.",
    Icon = "solar:play-bold",
    IconColor = Green,
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        if state then
            startFarm()
            notify("Auto Strike", "Auto strike enabled on " .. breaker.mode .. " mode.", "solar:play-bold")
        else
            stopFarm()
            notify("Auto Strike", "Auto strike disabled.", "solar:stop-bold")
        end
    end,
})

ControlSection:Space()

ControlSection:Toggle({
    Flag = "AutoFarmSync",
    Title = "Auto Farm Sync",
    Desc = "Secondary automation mirror for config saving.",
    Icon = "solar:refresh-bold",
    IconColor = Orange,
    Type = "Checkbox",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        if state then
            startFarm()
            notify("Auto Farm", "Auto farm sync enabled.", "solar:refresh-bold")
        else
            stopFarm()
            notify("Auto Farm", "Auto farm sync disabled.", "solar:refresh-bold")
        end
    end,
})

StrikeTab:Space()

local StrikeGroup = StrikeTab:Group({})

StrikeGroup:Button({
    Title = "Start",
    Desc = "Start the strike loop.",
    Icon = "solar:play-circle-bold",
    IconColor = Green,
    Color = Green,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        startFarm()
        notify("Strike", "Strike loop started.", "solar:play-circle-bold")
    end,
})

StrikeGroup:Space()

StrikeGroup:Button({
    Title = "Stop",
    Desc = "Stop the strike loop.",
    Icon = "solar:stop-circle-bold",
    IconColor = Red,
    Color = Red,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        stopFarm()
        notify("Strike", "Strike loop stopped.", "solar:stop-circle-bold")
    end,
})

StrikeTab:Space()

local ManualGroup = StrikeTab:Group({})

ManualGroup:Button({
    Title = "Single Hit",
    Desc = "Perform one manual strike now.",
    Icon = "solar:sledgehammer-bold",
    IconColor = Yellow,
    Color = Orange,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        performHit()
        notify("Manual Hit", "Single strike executed.", "solar:sledgehammer-bold")
    end,
})

ManualGroup:Space()

ManualGroup:Button({
    Title = "Reset Counters",
    Desc = "Reset bones, max velocity and hits per second.",
    Icon = "solar:restart-bold",
    IconColor = Grey,
    Color = Grey,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        breaker.totalBones = 0
        breaker.maxDamage = 0
        breaker.dps = 0
        notify("Statistics", "All counters reset.", "solar:restart-bold")
    end,
})

local StatsTab = FarmSection:Tab({
    Title = "Statistics",
    Desc = "Live bones and damage tracking",
    Icon = "solar:chart-bold",
    IconColor = Yellow,
    IconShape = "Square",
    Border = true,
})

StatsTab:Paragraph({
    Title = "Live Breaker Statistics",
    Desc = "Real time tracking of broken bones, hits per second, and maximum velocity.",
    Image = "solar:chart-bold",
    ImageSize = 36,
})

StatsTab:Space()

local LiveSection = StatsTab:Section({
    Title = "Live Counters",
    Desc = "Values update automatically every 0.2 seconds.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

local statsPara = LiveSection:Paragraph({
    Title = "Breaker Overview",
    Desc = "Broken: 0 | Hits/sec: 0 | Max Vel: 0",
    Image = "solar:pulse-bold",
    ImageSize = 28,
})

LiveSection:Space()

LiveSection:Paragraph({
    Title = "Session Info",
    Desc = "Mode: FAST | Power: 100% | Status: Idle",
    Image = "solar:info-circle-bold",
    ImageSize = 28,
})

local sessionPara = LiveSection:Paragraph({
    Title = "Session Time",
    Desc = "00:00:00",
    Image = "solar:clock-circle-bold",
    ImageSize = 28,
})

task.spawn(function()
    local startTime = tick()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.2)
        pcall(function()
            if statsPara and statsPara.SetDesc then
                statsPara:SetDesc("Broken: " .. tostring(breaker.totalBones) .. " | Hits/sec: " .. tostring(breaker.dps) .. " | Max Vel: " .. tostring(breaker.maxDamage))
            end
            local e = math.floor(tick() - startTime)
            local h = math.floor(e / 3600)
            local m = math.floor((e % 3600) / 60)
            local s = e % 60
            if sessionPara and sessionPara.SetDesc then
                sessionPara:SetDesc(string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s))
            end
        end)
    end
end)

StatsTab:Space()

local DetailSection = StatsTab:Section({
    Title = "Detailed View",
    Desc = "Individual stat toggles for focused monitoring.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

DetailSection:Toggle({
    Flag = "ShowBrokenCount",
    Title = "Track Broken Bones",
    Desc = "Include broken bone count in live updates.",
    Icon = "solar:bone-bold",
    IconColor = Red,
    Type = "Checkbox",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(state)
        notify("Statistics", state and "Broken bone tracking on." or "Broken bone tracking off.", "solar:bone-bold")
    end,
})

DetailSection:Space()

DetailSection:Toggle({
    Flag = "TrackVelocity",
    Title = "Track Max Velocity",
    Desc = "Include maximum velocity in live updates.",
    Icon = "solar:rocket-bold",
    IconColor = Blue,
    Type = "Checkbox",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(state)
        notify("Statistics", state and "Velocity tracking on." or "Velocity tracking off.", "solar:rocket-bold")
    end,
})

StatsTab:Space()

local StatsGroup = StatsTab:Group({})

StatsGroup:Button({
    Title = "Copy Stats",
    Desc = "Copy current stats to clipboard.",
    Icon = "solar:copy-bold",
    IconColor = Blue,
    Color = Blue,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        local text = "Broken: " .. breaker.totalBones .. " | Hits/sec: " .. breaker.dps .. " | Max Vel: " .. breaker.maxDamage
        if setclipboard then setclipboard(text) end
        notify("Statistics", "Stats copied: " .. text, "solar:copy-bold")
    end,
})

StatsGroup:Space()

StatsGroup:Button({
    Title = "Reset Stats",
    Desc = "Clear all statistic counters.",
    Icon = "solar:trash-bin-2-bold",
    IconColor = Orange,
    Color = Orange,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        breaker.totalBones = 0
        breaker.maxDamage = 0
        breaker.dps = 0
        notify("Statistics", "Statistics cleared.", "solar:trash-bin-2-bold")
    end,
})

local MovementTab = TeleportSection:Tab({
    Title = "Movement",
    Desc = "Dash and position utilities",
    Icon = "solar:map-point-bold",
    IconColor = Blue,
    IconShape = "Square",
    Border = true,
})

MovementTab:Paragraph({
    Title = "Movement Utilities",
    Desc = "Forward dash, upward boost, and position lock to control your breaker character.",
    Image = "solar:map-point-bold",
    ImageSize = 36,
})

MovementTab:Space()

local DashSection = MovementTab:Section({
    Title = "Dash Controls",
    Desc = "Manual velocity bursts using the same physics as auto strikes.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

DashSection:Slider({
    Flag = "DashPower",
    Title = "Dash Power",
    Desc = "Velocity used by manual dash buttons.",
    Icon = "solar:running-bold",
    IconColor = Blue,
    IsTooltip = true,
    IsTextbox = true,
    Icons = { From = "sfsymbols:sunMinFill", To = "sfsymbols:sunMaxFill" },
    Step = 10,
    Value = { Min = 50, Max = 500, Default = 200 },
    Callback = function(v)
        notify("Dash Power", "Dash power set to " .. tostring(v), "solar:running-bold")
    end,
})

MovementTab:Space()

local DashGroup = MovementTab:Group({})

DashGroup:Button({
    Title = "Forward Dash",
    Desc = "Dash forward with breaker velocity.",
    Icon = "solar:arrow-right-bold",
    IconColor = Blue,
    Color = Blue,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        local root = getRoot()
        if root then
            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
            bv.Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * (150 * breaker.power)
            bv.Parent = root
            Debris:AddItem(bv, 0.15)
            notify("Dash", "Forward dash executed.", "solar:arrow-right-bold")
        else
            notify("Dash", "No character found.", "solar:close-circle-bold")
        end
    end,
})

DashGroup:Space()

DashGroup:Button({
    Title = "Upward Boost",
    Desc = "Boost upward for better fall impact.",
    Icon = "solar:arrow-up-bold",
    IconColor = Purple,
    Color = Purple,
    Justify = "Center",
    Callback = function()
        local root = getRoot()
        if root then
            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 200 * breaker.power, 0)
            bv.Parent = root
            Debris:AddItem(bv, 0.15)
            notify("Boost", "Upward boost executed.", "solar:arrow-up-bold")
        else
            notify("Boost", "No character found.", "solar:close-circle-bold")
        end
    end,
})

MovementTab:Space()

local LockSection = MovementTab:Section({
    Title = "Position Lock",
    Desc = "Lock your character in place or reset physics state.",
    Box = true,
    BoxBorder = true,
    Opened = true,
})

LockSection:Toggle({
    Flag = "PositionLock",
    Title = "Enable Position Lock",
    Desc = "Locks your HumanoidRootPart at its current position.",
    Icon = "solar:lock-bold",
    IconColor = Purple,
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        posLockActive = state
        if state then
            local hrp = getHRP()
            if hrp then
                lockedCFrame = hrp.CFrame
                if posLockConn then pcall(function() posLockConn:Disconnect() end) end
                posLockConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local h = getHRP()
                    if h and lockedCFrame then
                        h.CFrame = lockedCFrame
                    end
                end)
                notify("Position Lock", "Your position is now locked.", "solar:lock-bold")
            else
                notify("Position Lock", "No character found.", "solar:close-circle-bold")
            end
        else
            if posLockConn then
                pcall(function() posLockConn:Disconnect() end)
                posLockConn = nil
            end
            lockedCFrame = nil
            notify("Position Lock", "Position lock released.", "solar:lock-keyhole-bold")
        end
    end,
})

    end

    if not ok then return false, tostring(accepted) end

    if type(getgc) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, objects = pcall(getgc, true)
    if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" then return false end
    local changed = false

            and rawget(object, "breakslevel") ~= nil then

            if replace or type(old) ~= "number" then

            changed = true

local file_storage = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function"

    _info = 1, scope = 2, version = 3, disclaimer = 4, global = 5,
    main_menu = 6, migrations = 7, values = 3, restore = 4, startup = 1, respawn = 2,
    accepted = 1

local function prettyjson(value, depth)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return http:JSONEncode(value) end
    local count, biggest, array = 0, 0, true
    for key in pairs(value) do
        count += 1
        if type(key) ~= "number" or key % 1 ~= 0 or key < 1 then
            array = false
        else
            biggest = math.max(biggest, key)
        end
    end
    if count == 0 then return "{}" end
    array = array and biggest == count
    local padding, inner = string.rep("  ", depth), string.rep("  ", depth + 1)
    local lines = {}
    if array then
        for index = 1, count do
            table.insert(lines, inner .. prettyjson(value[index], depth + 1))
        end
        return "[\n" .. table.concat(lines, ",\n") .. "\n" .. padding .. "]"
    end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do table.insert(keys, key) end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b)
        local left, right = jsonorder[a] or 100, jsonorder[b] or 100
        if left ~= right then return left < right end
        return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
    end)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        table.insert(lines, inner .. http:JSONEncode(tostring(key)) .. ": "
            .. prettyjson(value[key], depth + 1))
    end
    return "{\n" .. table.concat(lines, ",\n") .. "\n" .. padding .. "}"
end
local function rawfile(path)

    local raw = rawfile(path)

    local ok, data = pcall(http.JSONDecode, http, raw)

end
local function makefolders()
    if not file_storage then return false, "Executor file storage or folder creation is unavailable" end
    for _, path in ipairs({folder, scriptsfolder}) do
        local present = false
        if type(isfolder) == "function" then
            local ok, found = pcall(isfolder, path)
            present = ok and found == true
        end
        if not present then
            local ok, err = pcall(makefolder, path)
            if not ok then
                if type(isfolder) ~= "function" then return false, tostring(err) end
                local checked, found = pcall(isfolder, path)
                if not checked or not found then return false, tostring(err) end
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

    local ok, err = makefolders()
